workflow.title: Call to Book Your Appointment

faqs.question: What is TMD and how can you help?
faqs.answer: TMD (Temporo-Mandibular Joint Dysfunction) occurs when your bite position conflicts with where your jaw joints need to be for proper function. This can cause clicking jaw, headaches, neck pain, and sensitive teeth. Our specialist occlusal therapy team, led by Dr Charlotte Bishop, diagnoses and treats TMD through careful analysis of your bite and jaw joint position.

faqs.question: How do I book an appointment?
faqs.answer: Call us on 0117 924 6070 to make an appointment at a time that suits you. We offer flexible scheduling Monday to Friday, with hours from 8:00 AM to 6:45 PM depending on the day.

faqs.question: What if I need emergency dental care?
faqs.answer: We provide an out of hours emergency service for registered patients. Please call us on 0117 924 6070 and we will direct you to the appropriate emergency support.

faqs.question: Do you accept new patients?
faqs.answer: Yes, we welcome new patients. If you're considering a change of dentist, we promise comfortable treatment with appointment times to suit you. New patients receive a full assessment including two small x-rays.

faqs.question: What payment options do you offer?
faqs.answer: We offer Redland Dental Care, our private pay-as-you-go scheme for adults aged 25 and over. We accept cash, credit and debit card payments. Reduced private fees are available for patients under 25.

faqs.question: Is your practice wheelchair accessible?
faqs.answer: Due to the nature of our Victorian building, not all treatment rooms are wheelchair accessible. Please call us on 0117 924 6070 before your appointment so we can make arrangements to accommodate your needs.

reviews.author: Sarah M.
reviews.text: Excellent dental care in Bristol. The team really listens to your concerns and takes time to explain everything. My TMJ problems have improved significantly since treatment began. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: James T.
reviews.text: Finally found a dentist who takes my jaw pain seriously. Dr Charlotte Bishop is incredibly knowledgeable about occlusal therapy. The practice is welcoming and the Victorian building adds character. Great experience.

reviews.author: Emma R.
reviews.text: Switched dentists and couldn't be happier. The team at Redland Road is professional, friendly, and genuinely cares about patient comfort. Flexible appointment times made it easy to fit in around my schedule.

reviews.author: Michael P.
reviews.text: Outstanding emergency care when I needed it. Called with urgent dental pain and they fitted me in immediately. Professional, reassuring, and effective treatment. The out of hours service is brilliant.
